tier: macOS sandbox on Mac Studio M5 Max ($5 one-time credit)

free_tier.stated: $5 in free credit, no credit card needed; the account starts with $5 in free credit and the user adds credit by card in the console when it runs out
free_tier.notes: A one-time sign-up credit, at $1.10/hour about 4.5 hours of macOS sandbox time. No recurring free tier is published on the pricing or sign-up pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a macOS sandbox on a Mac Studio M5 Max, not an object store
per_object_cap.notes: No per-file or disk cap is published on the pages read.

retention.stated: unverified: no workspace-file retention period is stated on the pages read; sandboxes close after a job and the page shows per-team concurrency limits

egress.terms: not published as a per-GB price: usage is billed at $1.10 an hour by the second with no minimum; no outbound byte allowance or price per GB is stated on the pages read

interface_detail: An API key created in the console, pasted into an agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor; the page links a computer-use guide and a quickstart for direct API use. macOS sandboxes run Swift tests, Xcode and the iOS Simulator, and give an agent desktop control.
tooling: Console API keys, a documented API quickstart and agent integrations for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; no rclone backend is relevant to a Mac desktop sandbox.
chaining: The one-time $5 credit buys roughly 4.5 hours of a real Mac for computer-use, Xcode builds and iOS simulator tests; an agent pays for the sandbox from the account credit and queues for an available Mac when all are busy.

limits.value: 4 open sandboxes and 4 running CI jobs per team; additional CI jobs queue
$1.10 an hour billed by the second with no minimum; $5 one-time free credit at sign-up

limits_note: macOS 27, Xcode 27.2 and Apple silicon on a Mac Studio M5 Max; sandboxes queue for available Macs.
binding_note: The one-time $5 credit runs out after about 4.5 billed hours, before the per-team four-sandbox concurrency cap is reached in ordinary use.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page reads 'Sign up with a social provider or your email'; no credit card is needed for the $5 free credit. No phone, ID document or institution is asked for on that page.

reliability_note: Sandboxes queue for an available Mac and a team can run at most 4 open sandboxes and 4 CI jobs; additional CI jobs queue. The vendor states no matched build-speed benchmark against other Mac clouds.
confidence_note: The $1.10/hour rate, per-second billing with no minimum, $5 no-card credit, per-team limits and the email-or-social sign-up gate are quoted from first-page and sign-up pages read on 2026-11-25.
